Weather instruments include thermometers, barometers, anemometers, and wind vanes.
Weather symbols represent different weather conditions.
A local weather chart records weather observations over several days.
Weather charts can be interpreted to describe current weather conditions.
Comparing weather observations across days can reveal weather patterns.
Past weather observations can be used to predict possible future weather.
Weather forecasts are predictions and are not always certain.
PAGASA is the Philippine government agency that provides weather forecasts, typhoon warnin
Meteorologists are scientists who study and forecast weather.
A falling barometric pressure indicates bad weather.
Fine weather is characterized by a clear sky and calm wind.
